"""
Customer-facing lifecycle of an order
"""
enum OrderStatus {
  """
  Order is placed and waits for confirmation
  """
  RECEIVED
  """
  Order is confirmed and waits for the kitchen
  """
  CONFIRMED
  """
  Kitchen is preparing the order
  """
  PREPARING
  """
  Order is ready and waits for the courier
  """
  READY_FOR_PICKUP
  """
  Courier picked the order up and is on the way
  """
  PICKED_UP
  """
  Order is delivered
  """
  DELIVERED
  """
  Order is cancelled before fulfillment
  """
  CANCELLED
  """
  Order could not be fulfilled
  """
  FAILED
}

"""
Why an order ended without delivery
"""
enum OrderEndReason {
  """
  Customer cancelled the order
  """
  CUSTOMER_CANCELLED
  """
  Restaurant could not accept the order
  """
  RESTAURANT_REJECTED
  """
  Delivery did not succeed
  """
  DELIVERY_FAILED
  """
  Order was not fulfilled for another reason
  """
  NOT_FULFILLED
}

"""
Notable moment in the progress of an order
"""
enum OrderMilestoneKind {
  """
  Order is placed
  """
  PLACED
  """
  Order is confirmed
  """
  CONFIRMED
  """
  Kitchen started preparation
  """
  PREPARATION_STARTED
  """
  Order is ready for pickup
  """
  READY_FOR_PICKUP
  """
  Courier is assigned to the order
  """
  COURIER_ASSIGNED
  """
  Courier picked the order up
  """
  PICKED_UP
  """
  Order is delivered
  """
  DELIVERED
  """
  Order ended without delivery
  """
  ENDED
}

type OrderMilestone {

  Kind of the milestone
  """
  kind: OrderMilestoneKind!
  """
  Moment of the milestone in RFC 3339
  """
  occurredAt: String!
}

"""
Stage of a restaurant order in the kitchen
"""
enum KitchenOrderStage {
  """
  Order arrived and waits for the kitchen to accept or reject it
  """
  RECEIVED
  """
  Order is accepted and waits in the kitchen queue
  """
  QUEUED
  """
  Kitchen is preparing the order
  """
  PREPARING
  """
  Order is assembled and waits to be marked ready
  """
  ASSEMBLED
  """
  Order is ready for pickup
  """
  READY
}

"""
Line of a restaurant order as the kitchen sees it
"""
type KitchenOrderItem {
  """
  Display name of the menu item, empty if it is no longer in the menu
  """
  name: String!
  """
  Number of units
  """
  quantity: Int!
}

"""
Order of a restaurant as its kitchen sees it
"""
type KitchenOrder {
  """
  Restaurant order identifier, used by the kitchen commands
  """
  id: ID!
  """
  Customer order identifier
  """
  orderId: ID!
  """
  Current stage in the kitchen
  """
  stage: KitchenOrderStage!
  """
  Ordered items
  """
  items: [KitchenOrderItem!]!
  """
  Moment the restaurant received the order in RFC 3339
  """
  receivedAt: String!
}

"""
Active orders of one restaurant for its kitchen staff; the entity key lets the
Router resolve kitchenChanged events (ADR 36)
"""
type Kitchen @key(fields: "restaurantId") {
  """
  Identifier of the restaurant the kitchen belongs to
  """
  restaurantId: ID!
  """
  Restaurant the kitchen belongs to; menu is null
  """
  restaurant: Restaurant!
  """
  Orders in RECEIVED, QUEUED, PREPARING, ASSEMBLED and READY: RECEIVED by ascending
  receivedAt, then the kitchen queue order, then the rest by ascending receivedAt
  """
  orders: [KitchenOrder!]!
}

"""
Command of the kitchen over one restaurant order
"""
enum KitchenAction {
  """
  Accept a RECEIVED order into the kitchen queue
  """
  ACCEPT
  """
  Reject a RECEIVED order
  """
  REJECT
  """
  Start preparing a QUEUED order
  """
  START_PREPARATION
  """
  Mark a PREPARING order assembled
  """
  MARK_ASSEMBLED
  """
  Mark an ASSEMBLED order ready for pickup
  """
  MARK_READY
}

input KitchenActionInput {
  """
  Restaurant of the order
  """
  restaurantId: ID!
  """
  Restaurant order identifier (KitchenOrder.id)
  """
  kitchenOrderId: ID!
  """
  Command to apply
  """
  action: KitchenAction!
}

"""
Business reason why a kitchen command cannot be applied
"""
enum KitchenActionProblemCode {
  """
  The order is not in a stage that allows this command
  """
  ORDER_STAGE_CONFLICT
}

type KitchenActionPayload {
  """
  Order after the command; null if problem is set or the order left the kitchen
  """
  order: KitchenOrder
  """
  Business problem, null on success
  """
  problem: KitchenActionProblemCode
}

"""
Availability of a courier for new deliveries
"""
enum CourierAvailability {
  """
  Courier receives delivery offers
  """
  AVAILABLE
  """
  Courier is on a delivery
  """
  BUSY
  """
  Courier does not receive delivery offers
  """
  UNAVAILABLE
}

"""
Delivery offered to the courier, valid until expiresAt
"""
type DeliveryOffer {
  """
  Offer identifier
  """
  id: ID!
  """
  Delivery the offer is for
  """
  deliveryId: ID!
  """
  Customer order the delivery is for
  """
  orderId: ID!
  """
  Where to pick the order up
  """
  pickupAddress: String!
  """
  Moment in RFC 3339 after which the offer cannot be accepted
  """
  expiresAt: String!
}

"""
Stage of a delivery assigned to the courier
"""
enum CourierDeliveryStage {
  """
  Courier is going to the restaurant
  """
  ASSIGNED
  """
  Courier has the order and is going to the customer
  """
  PICKED_UP
}

"""
Delivery the courier is currently carrying out
"""
type CourierDelivery {
  """
  Delivery identifier
  """
  id: ID!
  """
  Customer order identifier
  """
  orderId: ID!
  """
  Current stage
  """
  stage: CourierDeliveryStage!
  """
  Where to pick the order up
  """
  pickupAddress: String!
}

"""
Work of the current courier; the entity key lets the Router resolve
courierChanged events (ADR 36)
"""
type Courier @key(fields: "id") {
  """
  Courier identifier, the subject of the current user
  """
  id: ID!
  """
  Current availability
  """
  availability: CourierAvailability!
  """
  Pending delivery offers, empty unless AVAILABLE
  """
  offers: [DeliveryOffer!]!
  """
  Delivery in progress, null if none
  """
  currentDelivery: CourierDelivery
}

"""
Command of the courier over the current delivery
"""
enum CourierDeliveryAction {
  """
  Confirm the order is picked up at the restaurant
  """
  CONFIRM_PICKUP
  """
  Confirm the order is handed to the customer
  """
  CONFIRM_DELIVERY
}

"""
Business reason why a courier command cannot be applied
"""
enum CourierProblemCode {
  """
  The offer expired or was taken
  """
  OFFER_NOT_AVAILABLE
  """
  The delivery is not in a stage that allows this command
  """
  DELIVERY_STAGE_CONFLICT
}

type CourierPayload {
  """
  Courier after the command
  """
  courier: Courier!
  """
  Business problem, null on success
  """
  problem: CourierProblemCode
}

type Query {
  """
  Metadata for the client BFF
  """
  bffInfo: BffInfo!
  """
  Restaurants available to the customer
  """
  restaurants(first: Int!, after: String): RestaurantConnection!
  """
  Restaurant by identifier, null if it does not exist
  """
  restaurant(id: ID!): Restaurant
  """
  Order of the current customer, null if it does not exist or belongs to someone else
  """
  order(id: ID!): Order
  """
  Orders of the current customer, newest first
  """
  customerOrders(first: Int!, after: String): OrderConnection!
  """
  Restaurants the current user owns, open and closed, ordered by identifier; menu is null
  """
  myRestaurants(first: Int!, after: String): RestaurantConnection!
  """
  Active orders of a restaurant for its kitchen; requires kitchen staff or the owner of the
  restaurant, null if the restaurant does not exist or the user may not operate its kitchen
  """
  kitchen(restaurantId: ID!): Kitchen
  """
  Work of the current user as a courier, null if the user is not a registered courier
  """
  courier: Courier
}

input OrderLineInput {
  """
  Menu item identifier
  """
  menuItemId: ID!
  """
  Number of units, at least 1
  """
  quantity: Int!
}

input PlaceOrderInput {
  """
  Restaurant to order from
  """
  restaurantId: ID!

  Ordered items
  """
  items: [OrderLineInput!]!

  Client-generated key of this checkout attempt, reused on manual retry
  """
  idempotencyKey: String!
}

"""
Business reason why an order cannot be placed
"""
enum PlaceOrderProblemCode {
  """
  One or more items cannot be ordered now
  """
  ORDER_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE
  """
  Order total is below the restaurant minimum
  """
  ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_MINIMUM
  """
  Order total is above the allowed maximum
  """
  ORDER_TOTAL_ABOVE_MAXIMUM
  """
  Restaurant does not accept orders now
  """
  RESTAURANT_NOT_ACCEPTING_ORDERS
}

type PlaceOrderProblem {
  """
  Reason code
  """
  code: PlaceOrderProblemCode!
  """
  Menu items the problem refers to, empty if it refers to the whole order
  """
  menuItemIds: [ID!]!
}

type PlaceOrderPayload {
  """
  Placed order, null if problems is not empty
  """
  order: Order
  """
  Business problems that prevented placing the order
  """
  problems: [PlaceOrderProblem!]!
}

input RequestOrderCancellationInput {
  """
  Order to cancel
  """
  orderId: ID!
  """
  Client-generated key of this cancellation attempt, reused on manual retry
  """
  requestId: String!
  """
  Optional free-text reason given by the customer
  """
  reason: String
}

"""
Accepted result of a cancellation request
"""
enum OrderCancellationOutcome {
  """
  Request is accepted and the order will be cancelled asynchronously
  """
  REQUESTED
  """
  Order was already cancelled
  """
  ALREADY_CANCELLED
}

"""
Business reason why cancellation cannot be requested
"""
enum OrderCancellationProblemCode {
  """
  Cancellation window has not opened yet
  """
  CANCELLATION_WINDOW_NOT_OPEN
  """
  Cancellation window has closed
  """
  CANCELLATION_WINDOW_EXPIRED
  """
  Order is already delivered or failed
  """
  ORDER_ALREADY_FINAL
}

type OrderCancellationProblem {
  """
  Reason code
  """
  code: OrderCancellationProblemCode!
}

type RequestOrderCancellationPayload {
  """
  Outcome, null if problem is set
  """
  outcome: OrderCancellationOutcome
  """
  Business problem, null if outcome is set
  """
  problem: OrderCancellationProblem
}

"""
Result of opening or closing a restaurant by its owner
"""
type RestaurantOpeningPayload {
  """
  Restaurant after the command; acceptingOrders is its opening state, menu is null
  """
  restaurant: Restaurant!
  """
  False when the restaurant was already in the requested state
  """
  changed: Boolean!
}

type Mutation {
  """
  Place an order for the current customer
  """
  placeOrder(input: PlaceOrderInput!): PlaceOrderPayload!
  """
  Request cancellation of an order of the current customer
  """
  requestOrderCancellation(input: RequestOrderCancellationInput!): RequestOrderCancellationPayload!
  """
  Open a restaurant of the current user for new orders; repeating it changes nothing
  """
  openRestaurant(restaurantId: ID!): RestaurantOpeningPayload!
  """
  Close a restaurant of the current user for new orders; repeating it changes nothing
  """
  closeRestaurant(restaurantId: ID!): RestaurantOpeningPayload!
  """
  Apply a kitchen command to a restaurant order; repeating START_PREPARATION or MARK_READY
  changes nothing
  """
  applyKitchenAction(input: KitchenActionInput!): KitchenActionPayload!
  """
  Change whether the current courier receives delivery offers; AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE only
  """
  setCourierAvailability(availability: CourierAvailability!): CourierPayload!
  """
  Accept a delivery offer addressed to the current courier
  """
  acceptDeliveryOffer(offerId: ID!): CourierPayload!
  """
  Apply a command to the current delivery of the courier
  """
  applyCourierDeliveryAction(deliveryId: ID!, action: CourierDeliveryAction!): CourierPayload!
}
